plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'Kinesiology AA-T Degree (Full Time)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 15, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7449/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Total Units 60 = 14+15+15+16 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Many universities require students to take their entire biology series at the same institution; see a counselor for details. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Transferable elective courses: any elective courses numbered 300-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. The CSU system requires American Institutions coursework; students can complete this requirement at ARC before transferring. See ASSIST.ORG for transfer requirements of the destination institution. Students with a cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better who complete 15 or more units of Honors coursework earn an Honors Transfer Certificate.
